newsitem.title: USA: Ampex shrs active on talk of future order.
newsitem.headline: Ampex shrs active on talk of future order.

text.p: Ampex Corp shares was most active traded stock on the American Stock Exchange on Friday, on speculation the company would receive an order for its Keepered Media product this year, an analyst said.
But Ampex said it had issued no news which would account for the increased trading activity in its shares.

Steve Ossad, an analyst at Genesis Merchant Securities, said there was growing belief that Ampex would receive a first purchase order for Keepered Media from a major disk drive supplier before year-end.

On Wednesday Dabney Resnick analyst Eric Appell reiterated his strong buy on Ampex for that reason, and the shares rose 2-3/8 to 9-1/2. Keepered Media is a technology for disks which go into disk drives, Appell said.
Ampex shares were trading at 10-1/8, up 5/8, on Friday on volume of 1.46 million shares.
Ampex reiterated that it could not comment on future orders.
